## Release Checklist
- [ ] I have tested the plugin on
  - [ ]  Windows
  - [ ]  macOS
  - [ ]  Linux
- [ ] My GitHub release contains all required files (as individual files, not just in the source.zip / source.tar.gz)
  - [ ] `main.js`
  - [ ] `manifest.json`
  - [ ] `styles.css` _(optional)_
- [ ] The GitHub release tag is exactly the `version` of my `manifest.json`, without a leading `v` (e.g. `1.0.0`, not `v1.0.0`).
- [ ] The `id` in my `manifest.json` matches the `id` in the `community-plugins.json` entry.
- [ ] The `id` is unique in `community-plugins.json`, and only uses lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
- [ ] My `README.md` describes the plugin's purpose and provides clear usage instructions.
- [ ] I have added a license in the `LICENSE` file.
- [ ] I have added my entry at the **end** of `community-plugins.json`.
- [ ] My project respects and is compatible with the original license of any code from other plugins that I'm using.
      I have given proper attribution to these other projects in my `README.md`.
